text:
kai: quick RFC note: proposing a microlane autoscale controller. motivation: many short-chat requests hurt tail latency; static microlane sizing either wastes GPU efficiency or underprovisions. controller autosizes host slots + tenant soft credits based on short_request_rate + pack_efficiency + kv_miss_budget.

maria: high-level sounds useful. main risks? oscillation, kv-cache storms, and cost regressions.

kai: agreed. design pillars: 1) conservative scale-up (require pack_efficiency above threshold), 2) kvcache_miss_budget gating, 3) PID-lite with integration cap + cooldown, 4) safe rollback and admin kill-switch.

tj: PID-lite needs test coverage. also define exact invariants: when do we refuse to scale? what triggers emergency scale-down?

kai: refuse scale-up if gpu_util > gpu_util_ceiling OR pack_efficiency < pack_min OR kvcache_miss_budget < miss_min. emergency scale-down if OOMs or sustained pack_efficiency collapse > 10% over 5m.

anya: how do we surface client-facing signals? 429 vs degraded path?

kai: two signals: (A) route-to-bulk + header "X-Redwood-Degraded: microlane" when microlane can't serve but bulk can, (B) 429 with Retry-After when we need clients to back off short bursts. SDKs should implement exponential backoff for 429.

lee: telemetry must include host.micro_slots, host.scale_events, host.pack_efficiency, host.kvcache_miss_budget_pct, short_request_429_rate, and tail percentiles by lane. alerts: 1) pack_efficiency < 0.7 sustained 5m, 2) 429_rate > 0.5% 10m, 3) cost_per_token +3% 15m.

sam: can we simulate adversarial clients? autoscale could be gamed. recommend per-tenant throttle caps and an opt-out flag.

kai: yes: per-tenant opt-out and per-host admin throttle cap. also a soft_quota that decays; noisy tenants hit quota and get routed to bulk.

ops-bot: infra checklist: add feature-flag "microlane_autoscale_v1", admin kill-switch, runbook entry for OOM/oscillation.

kai: config prototype: ```
microlane_autoscale:
  short_rate_threshold_per_sec: 100
  pack_efficiency_min: 0.72
  kvcache_miss_budget_min_pct: 25
  gpu_util_ceiling_pct: 90
  scale_up_step: 4
  scale_down_step: 2
  cooldown_ms: 60000
  integration_cap: 128
  opt_out_label: "no_microlane"
```

maria: rollout plan: dev -> staging synthetic traces (cross-model) -> 1% canary -> 10% -> 50% -> global. collect p99/p995, tokens/sec, kv_miss_delta, and cost_per_token.

tj: tests: unit tests for controller state machine, blackbox sim with adversarial patterns, integration test verifying no OOM on scale-up, and a KV-warmup sim to measure tail impact.

anya: docs: show tradeoffs, recommended defaults for chatty apps, and SDK guidance for handling 429 + degraded header. add per-tenant opt-out instructions.

lee: safety: autoscale defaults conservative; enable pack_efficiency gate by default. add automated rollback if cost_per_token > +3% or pack_efficiency drops > 10% for 10m.

kai: next steps: implement prototype in staging runner, wire metrics, run sims, and open RFC PR with plots and tests. tagging @maria @tj @lee for review before canary. :thumbsup:

maria: SGTM. please include cost table and tail percentiles in RFC.

tj: will review PR. ping me when available.

ops-bot: reminder: create runbook with emergency disable and owner oncall.
